Markets.title: Gold Silver Rates Live Updates: Gold falls over 2% as rate hike bets rise; silver edges lower
Markets.summary: Gold prices dropped by more than two percent following increased expectations of upcoming interest rate hikes. Meanwhile, silver prices also experienced a slight decline.

Markets.title: India pension funds pivot to bonds as equity exposure nears cap
Markets.summary: India's largest pension funds are shifting new investments away from stocks and toward government bonds as their equity exposure nears regulatory caps. This strategic pivot includes UTI Pension Fund allocating half of its new investments to bonds and SBI Pension Funds aiming to reduce its stock allocations to 25%.

Markets.title: Dollar takes breather ahead of US data on Fed path; Aussie jumps on CPI
Markets.summary: The US dollar remained steady as traders awaited key inflation and growth data before the Federal Reserve's expected interest rate decision. Meanwhile, the Australian dollar rose after domestic inflation exceeded forecasts, and Japanese service-sector prices hit a 36-year high.

Markets.title: Gold ticks lower ahead of US inflation data
Markets.summary: Gold prices fell slightly as investors awaited key US inflation data. Meanwhile, consumer confidence reached a nearly two-year high due to strong labor market reports.

Markets.title: Sensex Today | Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a positive start; Asian shares trade lower
Markets.summary: GIFT Nifty indicates a positive opening for the Indian stock market. Meanwhile, Asian shares are trading lower.

Markets.title: Market timers get schooled as S&P 500 swings rip up playbooks
Markets.summary: Investors who attempt to time the stock market often hurt their returns because they miss rapid recoveries following sharp declines. Experts note that these unpredictable and volatile swings are becoming increasingly frequent, making it difficult to maintain investments.

Geo-Political.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
Geo-Political.summary: Nvidia's share price fell seven percent after lawmakers questioned President Donald Trump's involvement in CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement. The US attorney general avoided answering questions regarding an investigation into the matter.

Geo-Political.title: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
Geo-Political.summary: Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife, Carla Bruni, will stand trial. This is the latest legal case involving Sarkozy, who became the first former French president sent to prison last year.

Geo-Political.title: Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
Geo-Political.summary: Indian immigration authorities at Delhi airport barred Saurav Das from a UK flight after flagging his passport. Das, who was previously called a "cockroach" by a UK politician, stated that the Indian government has "lost the plot."

Geo-Political.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
Geo-Political.summary: A New York jury found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets following a months-long trial. However, the court acquitted the company of racketeering charges.

Geo-Political.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
Geo-Political.summary: Leftover explosives from the Syrian war have killed or injured nearly 1,000 children. These casualties have soared two years after the official end of the conflict.

Geo-Political.title: Nigerian monarch, 92, suspended after sexual assault claims
Geo-Political.summary: Nigeria has suspended the 92-year-old Emir of Daura following allegations of sexual assault. The monarch is one of the country's most prominent traditional leaders.

AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how apps and games work without viewing their source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code to analyze software features.

Data & Insights.title: Hiccups! Why Scotch whisky is caught in a tariff row and shipments are being seized | Explained amid India-UK trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: India and the UK are currently locked in a trade dispute over the classification of Scotch whisky, resulting in more than 80 container shipments being seized at Indian ports. British whisky makers face potential import duties as high as 162.5% while trade deal negotiations continue.

Data & Insights.title: Explained | While US-China agreement offers trade relief, why firms may not reverse their costly supply-chain moves
Data & Insights.summary: China has extended its suspension of export restrictions on key minerals to the US until January 2027, easing supply chain concerns. However, businesses that have already invested in costly alternative suppliers are likely to keep them despite this temporary relief.

Data & Insights.title: US prepares fresh tariff hikes on China and India over industrial subsidies; announcement expected this week
Data & Insights.summary: The Trump administration is preparing new tariffs on China, India, and 15 other economies regarding industrial subsidies. An official announcement detailing these higher duties is expected this week.

Data & Insights.title: States raise  ₹7 trillion in market borrowings so far in FY27, 12% below plan
Data & Insights.summary: Indian states have raised ₹7 trillion through market borrowings in fiscal year 2027, which is 12% below their planned target. Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and Karnataka drove nearly 62% of this borrowing increase while the central government reduced its own borrowing program.

Data & Insights.title: More credit, but large gaps: the challenge ahead for Mudra and Stand-Up India push
Data & Insights.summary: The government has extended Mudra loan guarantees and Stand-Up India for five years to maintain small-business credit. However, persistent issues like unequal beneficiary shares, rising loan sizes, and repayment stress highlight significant challenges for inclusive growth.

Data & Insights.title: India-UK trade deal cuts Scotch whisky duty to 75%, but bulk imports face 110% levy; govt working to resolve dispute
Data & Insights.summary: The India-UK trade deal reduces the duty on bottled Scotch whisky to 75%, while high-strength bulk spirits imported for blending face a 110% levy. The Indian government is currently working to resolve this ongoing dispute over bulk import duties.

India.title: Bengaluru Metro Blue Line Trial Begins From KR Puram, Targets Mid-2027 Opening For Public
India.summary: Trial runs for Bengaluru's Metro Blue Line have begun from KR Puram following a 2016-17 recognition of the need for Outer Ring Road connectivity. The line is targeted to open for the public by mid-2027.

India.title: 2 Accused Who Robbed, Murdered Assam Family Injured In Police Encounter
India.summary: Police in Dibrugarh arrested a tenant named Raju Das and his associate for robbing and murdering a couple and their daughter in Duliajan. Both suspects were injured during a police encounter following the arrests.

India.title: Miranda House Offers 15 Certificate Courses In AI, Filmmaking, Animation
India.summary: Miranda House is launching 15 new certificate courses, including programs in AI filmmaking and animation. These courses aim to train students in AI-enabled content creation and prepare them for the creator economy's commercial aspects.

India.title: Nepal PM Balen Shah's India Visit Marks New Chapter In Ties, Says Brother-In-Law
India.summary: Nepal Prime Minister Balen Shah's brother-in-law stated that Shah's India visit marks a new chapter in bilateral relations. Sejekan also highlighted that Shah's political rise is remarkable because he achieved success without a political dynasty or traditional backing.

India.title: Kerala Student Carrying Gun To 'Show Off' Accidentally Shoots Classmate
India.summary: A Kerala student accidentally shot his classmate in the bicep after bringing a gun to school to show off. The injured student is currently undergoing surgery to have the bullet removed.

India.title: Akhilesh Yadav's Open Letter, Then A Move That Overlaps Congress Wishlist
India.summary: The Congress party wants one hundred seats in the upcoming seat-sharing arrangement, but the Samajwadi Party is reluctant to spare more than 26 seats. This significant numerical gap highlights the current tensions and dynamics within their alliance.

General.title: Nuclear test veterans will get full truth, says Burnham, as he confirms independent panel
General.summary: The prime minister confirmed that an independent panel will investigate the health impacts of Britain's Cold War nuclear tests. This Hillsborough-style review aims to provide nuclear test veterans with the full truth regarding their medical legacy.

General.title: Nuclear test veterans speak to BBC about search for justice
General.summary: Andy Burnham confirmed plans for an investigation into the health legacy of Britain's Cold War-era atomic programme. Nuclear test veterans spoke to the BBC about their ongoing search for justice and the truth.

General.title: Anthony Zurcher: Trump's Nvidia intervention ties his political fortunes to the AI boom
General.summary: US President Donald Trump intervened to reinstate Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. This action inextricably links Trump's political fortunes and future fate to the ongoing artificial intelligence boom.

General.title: Thomas Markle indicted in US for possessing child sex abuse images
General.summary: The FBI arrested Thomas Markle on November 6 after finding child sex abuse images in a Los Angeles storage unit he allegedly rented. He has now been indicted in the United States for possessing this material.

General.title: Third of young Brits have never had sex, but many are sexting and watching porn
General.summary: A third of young people in Britain have never had sex. However, many of them actively engage in sexting and watch pornography.

General.title: Households braced for soaring energy bills with new price cap to be announced
General.summary: Regulator Ofgem will announce a new price cap that will significantly raise domestic gas prices in January. Households across the country are now preparing for these soaring energy bills.
